description: Web app that converts 2D images into immersive 3D skybox environments with interactive preview

userStories.title: Project Setup with HTML/CSS/JS structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a clean project structure so that development can proceed smoothly
acceptanceCriteria: Create index.html with basic HTML5 structure
Create styles.css with CSS variables for theming
Dark theme with modern UI aesthetic

userStories.title: Image Upload Component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to upload an image via drag-drop or file picker so that I can convert it to a skybox
acceptanceCriteria: Drag and drop zone with visual feedback

userStories.title: Three.js Skybox Viewer Setup
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my image in an interactive 3D skybox so that I can explore it
acceptanceCriteria: Create sphere geometry with inverted normals for skybox
Map uploaded image as texture onto sphere

userStories.title: Fullscreen Mode
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view the skybox in fullscreen so that I get an immersive experience
acceptanceCriteria: Resize canvas properly on fullscreen change

userStories.title: Export Equirectangular Image
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download the skybox as an equirectangular image so that I can use it elsewhere
acceptanceCriteria: Render current view to downloadable PNG

userStories.title: Mobile Touch Controls
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want touch controls to work smoothly so that I can explore on my phone
acceptanceCriteria: Prevent default scroll behavior in viewer

userStories.title: Polish and Final Touches
userStories.description: As a user, I want a polished experience with loading states and smooth animations
acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard shortcuts (F for fullscreen, R for reset view)
